findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “By the end of the first week”
findings.source_quote: “With a comically pathetic expression, he would offer Sterling and I each one of his little paddies to hold while he ate, as if that gave him courage.”
findings.suggested_fix: Badili “kila mmoja mojawapo ya vibao vyake vidogo tuishike” kuwa “kila mmoja wetu mikono yake midogo tuishike” ili kurejesha maana ya kumpa kila mzazi mkono wake mdogo washike.
findings.translation_quote: “Akiwa na sura ya kuchekesha yenye huzuni, angenipa mimi na Sterling kila mmoja mojawapo ya vibao vyake vidogo tuishike alipokuwa akila, kana kwamba jambo hilo lilimpa ujasiri.”
